title: Wonderlands×Showtime Chapter1 Episode8 Robo-Nene on Stage?!

rows.Line: Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
That's a big robot!
She comes up to my waist!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What is this, Rui? You were supposed to bring a new cast member, not another robot!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's a little complicated. First, I should explain that this isn't an autonomous robot of the sort I used at the show yesterday. This one's remotely controlled.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You made it yourself?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I did indeed.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It requires charging only once every three days, and comes with many functions optimized for use on stage. I'm quite pleased with how it turned out.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I don't need your boasting!
Where is the person controlling this thing?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She's nearby. Don't worry, she has been fully trained in the control of this robot.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Sigh... Listen, Rui.
We're not looking for a robot, we're looking for a real human to join our shows.

rows.Speaker: Robot
rows.Line: You got a problem with me?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oooh, she spoke!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, she can talk through the robot, and can also see you on her controller's display.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm Emu Otori! It's nice to meet you, Little Robot♪

rows.Speaker: Robot
rows.Line: Otori? That name sounds familiar...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Little Robot, do you have a name?

rows.Speaker: Robot
rows.Line: A name... Um...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Come to think of it, we haven't named the robot.
Could you tell them your name instead this time?

rows.Speaker: Robot
rows.Line:
.....
Nene Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thanks! I'll call the robot Robo-Nene♪

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Robo-Nene... I guess that's fine.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: If we can converse through this contraption, I have something to tell you, Nene Kusanagi!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You may not have heard, but we do musicals. And with a star such as myself on stage, every other actor's performance must also be of the highest caliber!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You obviously can neither dance nor sing with that robot. I'm sorry, but we cannot accept you as a member of our troupe.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Hmph. You call yourself a star, but you can't even recognize talent when you see it?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-What?!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line:
You think a robot can't dance?
Maybe you need a demonstration?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's a good idea, Nene. Perform a little display of both your and the robot's abilities. Emu, could you put on some music, please?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Sure☆
Robo-Nene, it's showtime!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmph, you can try. No matter how skilled Rui may be at building robots, it can't possibly—

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: She's...tap dancing?! With those stubby little legs?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, that's very good, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa! Her feet are tap-tapping so fast!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
And now a smooth jazz dance?
This shouldn't be possible with that short, squat stature!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's so awesome! Robo-Nene, you're a great dancer!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Well?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Uh... Dancing is one thing, but singing is just as important in musicals! I can't have a poor singer in the cast!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Hmph. So if I sing, I'm hired?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wooow! That was a beautiful song!
And such a beautiful singing voice too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No way, she can't be great at everything!
Ah... I get it. That was a recording of someone else singing, wasn't it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But Tsukasa, that was Robo-Nene's voice.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Uh...

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: What now? Anything else you want me to prove?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, Tsukasa? Does Nene not meet all your requirements?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I suppose she's good enough to perform with us...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
But what if she steals the limelight from me?!
No, that's not possible, I'm the true star here...

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: You don't have to let me join if it's going to make you feel insecure.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Y-You heard that?! Well, I'm going to become the world's top star! Insecurity is a feeling entirely alien to me!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Oh, really?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Why are you giving me that dubious look!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Oh, you could tell? How amazing, Mr. Future Star.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
You're awfully confrontational.
But I understand. You're simply jealous of my talent.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Haha, I can see you two will get along well.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa! Tsukasa! I want to do shows with Robo-Nene!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: She's so good! It must be because she really loves theater and has practiced lots and lots! I adore her!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Uh... I admit, her singing and dancing pass muster...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then... Then she can join us? Can she?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay, I'll allow it! She'll be our fourth member.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yaaay! Welcome to the team, Robo-Nene and Nene!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Um, thanks.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Be grateful for my magnanimous nature.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Don't even think of sabotaging me on stage, or I'll fire my beam at you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: B-Beam?! This thing has a laser?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's make great shows together, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nene, they've gone now. You can come out.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: There's got to be something wrong with them, hiring a robot as a troupe member...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I agree, they all seem rather crazy.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Look who's talking. You suddenly appeared with a robot, inviting me to do shows with you again. Like that's normal.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You knew I'd given up theater.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Really? Then why did you come?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
.....
You're an awful human being.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, we both have our faults.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, aren't you bored playing games at home all day? Think of this as a new kind of game and have some fun.
